voiceLines.voiceStyle: Calm, businesslike American woman in her forties, slightly hurried, steady professional insurance-broker tone, a little concerned underneath, quiet office behind her, natural voicemail delivery with small hesitations
voiceLines.text: Morning, it's your account exec at Midland Risk Partners, calling for the general counsel. I'm seeing Tallis on the wire, and your stock's down about six percent, and, um, I don't have a claim notice from you yet. So the CFO needs to call the claims line within twenty-four hours of discovery, and from what I'm reading, the clock started around six forty this morning. When I take this to Redwater, the underwriter's going to ask three things. One, are you using Cardinal Forensics through counsel. Two, have the FBI and CISA been notified, and what are the reference numbers. And three, has anyone in a public statement admitted fault, or promised to cover customer losses. And please... don't let anybody promise customer credit monitoring or refunds before we've talked. Okay, call me back at this number. Thanks.
